units.text: Two a.m. Wet road. Empty streets. Nothing on the radio but static.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Five stars is all I ask, folks. Everyone buckled?
units.name: JAMAL
paren: eyes in the mirror, thumb tapping the wheel

units.name: COLE
paren: slumped against the window, fogging the glass

units.text: Four kids from a party. Three of them quiet. One of them loud. Always one.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Cole, tell him what you did. Tell Jamal what you did at Tasha's.
units.name: RUBEN
paren: leaning forward between the seats, grinning

units.text: He told her he loved her. Then he threw up in her mom's plant.
units.name: BIANCA
paren: arms folded, not looking at either boy

units.name: SHAY
paren: whispering, holding a phone dark in her lap

units.text: Red light. Rain. Nobody talks. The wipers keep time.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Jamal, can you drop me first? Please. He said he'd call and he's not going to, and I don't want him to see me cry.
units.name: MIKA
paren: from the front passenger seat, finally, softly

units.text: He means the other he, Cole.
units.name: SHAY
